titles.ja: 君は放課後インソムニア

1.overview: When Ganta Nakami goes into the observatory, rumored to be haunted, he finds his classmate Isaki Magari sound asleep! They learn they’re both struggling with the same problem.

2.overview: Ganta and Isaki have experienced lonely nights as they each struggle with sleeplessness. They form a “Nightly Fun Society” using the observatory as a secret base.

3.overview: When another student expresses interest in joining the Astronomy Club, it makes things a lot more complicated for Ganta!
3.summary:
When another student expresses interest in joining the Astronomy Club, it makes things a lot more complicated for Ganta!
Source: HIDIVE

4.overview: Ganta invites Isaki to the fireworks festival, swearing that they’d only be going together for “photography practice”, and Isaki promptly accepts.
4.summary:
Ganta invites Isaki to the fireworks festival, swearing that they`d only be going together for "photography practice", and Isaki promptly accepts.
Source: HIDIVE

5.overview: On a cloudy seaside class trip, Isaki makes a promise with Ganta to meet on the beach under the starry sky if the weather clears up.
5.summary:
On a cloudy seaside class trip, Isaki makes a promise with Ganta to meet on the beach under the starry sky if the weather clears up.
Source: HIDIVE

6.overview: The heat is unbearable! The lack of AC doesn’t help. Even the breeze is too warm. It's almost too hot to take pictures.
6.summary:
The heat is unbearable! The lack of AC doesn’t help. Even the breeze is too warm. It`s almost too hot to take pictures.
Source: HIDIVE

7.overview: Isaki and Ganta try to hand out fliers at the Shokusai Market for a meteor shower viewing party. Will anyone take them up on their offer?
7.summary:
Isaki and Ganta try to hand out fliers at the Shokusai Market for a meteor shower viewing party. Will anyone take them up on their offer?
Source: HIDIVE

8.overview: It’s almost time for summer break! If that weren’t enough to be excited about, the Astronomy Club plans a meteor shower viewing party.
8.summary:
It’s almost time for summer break! If that weren’t enough to be excited about, the Astronomy Club plans a meteor shower viewing party.
Source: HIDIVE

9.overview: After the viewing party was rained out, Ganta plans to shoot pictures of the starry night sky and then use them to enter a contest.

10.overview: Despite starting a part-time job, Ganta hasn’t raised enough money for training camp. But thanks to Isaki staying at her grandmother’s house, their problems are solved.
10.summary:
Despite starting a part-time job, Ganta hasn’t raised enough money for training camp. But thanks to Isaki staying at her grandmother’s house, their problems are solved.
Source: HIDIVE

11.overview: On the second day of their training camp, Ganta and Isaki’s adventure begins with a trip to Mitsukejima.
11.summary:
On the second day of their training camp, Ganta and Isaki’s adventure begins with a trip to Mitsukejima.
Source: HIDIVE

12.overview: With their chaperone Haya now gone, Ganta and Isaki are left all alone at her grandmother’s house.
12.summary:
With their chaperone Haya now gone, Ganta and Isaki are left all alone at her grandmother’s house.
Source: HIDIVE

13.overview: Isaki’s parents find out that she and Ganta have been staying all by themselves. Naturally, they demand that Isaki come home right away, but she refuses.
